entities.name: José Pedraza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Pedraza González is a Puerto Rican professional boxer. He won world championships in two weight divisions, having held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) super featherweight title from 2015 to 2017, and the World Boxing Organization (WBO) lightweight title in 2018.
